title: About me
paragraphs: My name is Mário Travassos, a highly-motivated, passionate Software Developer from Portugal. I'm deeply interested in **Computer Graphics**, **Web Design and Development** and **Interaction Design**.
I have a solid foundation in **Front-end** and **Full-stack** web technologies, and I seek to deliver **engaging immersive user experiences**.

I started my academic journey at ||FEUP[fe.up.pt]||, where I developed my dissertation work focused on studying cutting-edge 3D reconstruction techniques, with the ultimate goal of **streamlining the creation of photo-realistic WebVR experiences**.
Later, I studied **Interaction Design, Web and Games** at ||FBAUP[fba.up.pt]||, where my final project was focused on dissecting **Provocative Game Mechanics**.

Away from the digital world, you can find me engaging in multiple activities, from **repairing and tinkering** to **reading**, **cooking** or **playing video or trading card games**. I am also an avid **language learning enthusiast**, and I am currently hard at work studying japanese.
paragraphs2: I am currently a **3D Software Engineer** at ||Infinite Foundry[infinitefoundry.com/]||.
As part of my language-learning journey, I keep on **sentence-mining** and **immersing in japanese media**, with the goal of further improving my japanese language proficiency.
All the while, I continue **making interactive web applications** as a hobby.
